protocol: Sequential local servers, one process per mode. 15 input/8 output warmup, then two timed uncached 4000/64 requests and a separate untimed 4000/65 greedy FP32 logit capture per cap. Seed 42, ignored EOS. Resize before a 15/7 request in the same process. TTFT excludes startup. Decode measures first to last token at the client. Decode logical expert reads span first output to next request start. File caching uncontrolled. Physical footprint sampled separately from engine usage. Qwen direct layers and admission of budgeted DFlash2 at 24/12 GiB were enabled in a temporary diagnostic build. Both controls reserve combined MoE space at resize.
logit_comparison_notes: The two SHA-256 digests follow the order of modes in each comparison. The two row counts indicate total captured rows in that same order. Aligned rows include the first prediction on which token choices diverge. FP32 differences and top-1 agreement use only rows conditioned on identical preceding tokens. Equal output IDs counts matching positions in the entire sequence.
read_counter_notes: logical_read_bytes counts expert-store payloads, including OS page-cache hits. It excludes direct banks and the separate wide prefill reader. disk_read_bytes is the process I/O counter for the whole request.
qualification_notes: The production budgeted DFlash2 profile for this Qwen accepts 8 GiB. The diagnostic build admitted 24 and 12 GiB and selectively bound resident experts for this checkpoint. Direct layer admission used the LFM allowance (fixed floor plus 2 GiB reserved). Manual resize suspended automatic wide prefill. Draft and target charge the same ledger.
